neuvillette.settings.page.title: Neuvillette
Eases Neuvillette's learning curve during the first 10 runs without changing the selected Ascension level.
Enabled by default; changes apply next run. The first 3 runs progressively introduce Surge, Sourcewater Droplets, and their payoffs while preserving random choices. On death, one run-wide guidance charge revives you at 30% Max HP; charges do not refresh after combat.
neuvillette.settings.difficulty.status.c: Onboarding complete · Vanilla Ascension rules only
Judicial Guidance eases the learning curve of your first 10 Neuvillette runs without changing Ascension. Its limited revives are shared across the entire run and do not refresh after combat. You can toggle it here or in Mod Settings.
neuvillette.settings.section.act4.title: Act 4
neuvillette.settings.act4.enabled.label: Enable Act 4
neuvillette.settings.act4.enabled.descri: When enabled, proceed to Act 4 after Act 3. When disabled, the run ends after Act 3 as in vanilla.
neuvillette.settings.multiplayer_court.e: When enabled, Submit cards can appear in multiplayer. They are excluded by default.
neuvillette.settings.sponsor_relic.enabl: When enabled, sponsor relics (e.g. Cat Cake) can appear in runs. When disabled, they are excluded.
